M2 remains the sole diagnostic authority; Phase 1B remains FAIL / NO-GO.

phases.finding: max loss-free eBPF NET_RX on CPU 18 = 0.166 cores at 320k pps; S2 needs >= 0.666 (SI_ABS_MIN 0.5 + delta 0.166); 640k pps: 0.327 cores with ~22% receiver-socket loss (RcvbufErrors), softnet drops 0

phases.validated_scope: cgroup memory.high file-backed page-cache refault pressure, diagnosed through the MP.R1 reclaim-and-refault path; not general Linux memory pressure
phases.result: calibration feasible; M1 x3 (H 768 MiB) and M2 x3 (H 512 MiB): ground truth established 6/6, M2 memory_pressure 6/6 (MEDIUM); N1 x2: no pressure, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE 2/2; N2 x2: cpu_contention 2/2; E0 x2: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; 0 memory_pressure false positives; 0 disagreements; 12 evidence runs + 1 calibration = 13 executions

steps.design: GO (review session; decisions Q1 ebpf default required, Q2 r2c-validation-uncalibrated, Q3 snapshot.incident_id None)
steps.2A.2_snapshot_replay_verify: PASS (58/58 replayable committed snapshots reproduce recorded M2; 32/32 mutants)
steps.2A.3_raw_tick_replay: PASS (no historical tick corpus; synthetic + 70 committed eBPF streams; 24/24 mutants)
steps.2A.4_live_m3a_acquisition: PASS (injected readers only; eBPF and interfaces refused; 22/22 mutants)
steps.2A.5_first_live_acquisition: PASS: /system.slice/cron.service, exit 11 PARTIAL, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, verify 0, replay ticks + snapshot MATCH; BPF state unverified (needs root)
steps.2A.6_closeout: evidence copy + provenance, integrity maintenance, report, commit

experimentally_validated_fault_classes: memory_pressure (scoped: cgroup memory.high file-backed page-cache refault pressure, reclaim-and-refault path; R2-F)

precedence: PR-3 contention vs throttling: cpu_throttling 3/3 in R2-D TC (time_rate ~0.686 vs run_delay_excess ~0.151, DOM_RATIO 2.0)

known_limitations: Phase 2A: live acquisition is M3A-only (eBPF and interface/qdisc sources refused); live runs are outside the validated M3A + eBPF configuration
Phase 2A: one live run only (idle cron.service, no fault); no live diagnostic-accuracy claim
Phase 2A: unlimited cpu.max / memory.max encode as Bad(ABSENT), so such targets always yield PARTIAL acquisitions; read PARTIAL with bad_counts
Phase 2A: no historical tick corpus; registry holds only r2c-validation-uncalibrated (R2-B snapshots not replayable)
Phase 2A: BPF program/attachment state not verified for the live run (needs root)
R2-F: no graded severity — M1 (H 768 MiB) and M2 (H 512 MiB) both ~46k refaults/s and ~45x cycle-time increase; M2 does not demonstrate greater observed severity than M1
R2-F: PSI path untested — memory_pressure asserted via MP.R1 reclaim-and-refault; psi.mem.some.target ~0.021 < registered 0.2 floor; PSI-based memory-pressure detection not validated
R2-F: OOM path untested (OOM prohibited by the registered safety design)
R2-F: validated mechanism is cgroup memory.high + file-backed page cache + reclaim/refault thrashing only; anonymous-memory, swap-driven and OOM pressure not validated
R2-F: single host, Ubuntu 22.04, kernel 6.8.0-138 (MGLRU), one registered campaign; no cross-host/kernel claim
R2-F: r2f_memory.py evaluate expects a ground-truth window and does not directly evaluate the calibration directory (tooling limitation, not a runtime failure; not fixed)
R2-F: host rebooted after R2-E; R2-F baseline = post-reboot state (swap 0 used; root controllers cpuset cpu io memory hugetlb pids rdma misc, restored by Docker); not normalised to the R2-E state

tests/test_phase1a.py mutates the host (docker run hello-world restores root cgroup controllers, docker0 IPv6 link-local); excluded (24 tests) from the R2-F verification regression; after a reboot, R2-C/R2-D live dry-run tests fail until Docker has run (R2-C exact ROOT_SUBTREE preflight)
R2-E: softirq_overload NOT validated — registered ladder could not reach S2 without loss (receiver/socket bottleneck before CPU 18 reached SI_ABS_MIN + delta)

R2-E: tick-sampled /proc/stat softirq fraction (SI.R1 input) read 0.0000 while eBPF measured up to 0.166 cores on an otherwise idle NO_HZ CPU; 0.53 vs 0.33 under load — measurement limitation, no M2/M3A change

R2-D: throttle.quota_saturation not validated under binding throttling (MISSING in all 9 T1/T2/TC runs; M3A rejects per-interval values > 1.0); supporting metric only — not a failure of the mandatory R2-D evidence or ground truth
R2-C E1: strong tail/PSI/run-delay degradation, M2 cpu_contention 3/3, but the approved G4 median-lateness criterion stayed FALSE (ground truth: not established) — recorded disagreement
cpu.util.cpuset has a /proc/stat tick-accounting bias when CPU 18 is partially busy
M2 confidence limited to MEDIUM by IMPACT_NOT_MEASURED (no application metrics)
thresholds are engineering/safety values (validation parameter set), not statistically calibrated; parameters.json UNCALIBRATED
host must keep openvpn-server@server.service disabled (crash-loop host noise otherwise)
